scope: Task_ProcessInput, CycleInput and TD/MENUITEM enum layout in src/bw_option_menu.c
coverage: Both HACK_NO_MOEMON variants; every valid item/top pair and all A/B/up/down key combinations (1344 navigation cases), plus 112 valid 2..5-choice left/right cases. Checks task-data layout fits 16 slots, menu fields align with contiguous selections, cursor wrap, scroll top update, 0..5 background map index, save/cancel key priority, countdown setup and simultaneous direction behavior.
findings: No navigation or valid-selection cycling defect found in this scope.
limitations: ProcessInputFor mocked as unchanged, drawing and decompression mocked. Actual per-item choice dispatch, invalid selection handling, save writes, graphics and linked game runtime remain unverified.
